infobox.usage: Unlocks apartment 5 on the third floor of the old apartment building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Cult victim's apartment key (Cult victim) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to an apartment in an older building. It seems to have been taken during the victim’s torture to later access their apartment.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter They Are Already Here

sections.heading: Lighthouse
sections.text: In one of four locations in one of the houses in the village on the eastern island. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to apartment 5 on the third floor of the old apartment building behind the Klimov shopping mall at Streets of Tarkov.
